"""由需求整理的 demo 场景，复用框架已有 Service。"""
import pytest

from autotest.api.services import ItemsService

pytestmark = [pytest.mark.api, pytest.mark.demo, pytest.mark.regression]


@pytest.mark.case(id='AUTHOR-ITEM-LIFECYCLE', purpose='项目创建查询删除', expected='创建后查询内容一致，删除后返回 404', basis="requirement", source="requirement")
def test_item_lifecycle(authenticated_client, unique_item_name):
    service = ItemsService(authenticated_client)
    created = service.create(unique_item_name)
    assert created.status_code == 201
    item = created.json()
    try:
        assert item["id"]
        assert item["name"] == unique_item_name
        fetched = service.get(item["id"])
        assert fetched.status_code == 200
        assert fetched.json() == item
        assert service.delete(item["id"]).status_code == 204
        assert service.get(item["id"]).status_code == 404
    finally:
        assert service.delete(item["id"]).status_code in {204, 404}

notes: 离线协议样例，不代表调用过在线模型。复用 ItemsService 和 authenticated_client。
